meta.title: Sinking Levi 501's in a River for 1 Week!
meta.description:
Want to buy 501's? https://fave.co/3DFMF9A

Sinking Levi's 501 jeans in a river for one week! Dumb? Maybe, I don't know but I wanted to see what would happen. These are Levi 501's STF (shrink to fit)! They are raw, unsanforized denim straight from Levi's HQ, not selvedge! Not to be confused with Levi's LVC brand (WHICH I WILL BE REVIEWING IF LEVI'S STOPS SENDING ME FAULTY PAIRS). 

I want to start a series on doing stuff like this to raw denim. But maybe just Levi's to start and then when I'm rich and famous I'll try Unbranded or Naked and Famous.
